business_description.value: The company is a Singapore Community Living operator that runs an asset-light model to manage and operate residential and other property assets under six brands. It also provides property management, referral and project management services, and takes minority stakes in companies that own property assets.
business_description.quote: We operate an asset-light model that leverages our digital infrastructure to manage and operate our portfolio of property assets through our Group and Associated Companies.
